entities.summary: Masako Mori is a Japanese politician and lawyer who has served in the House of Councillors since 2007, and as Minister of Justice from October 2019 to September 2020. She is a member of the Liberal Democratic Party. Masako Mori was a legal figures from Iwaki (b. 1964-08-22, Iwaki). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
